display_name: LoRa W24 冻结恢复修正方向与强度互换（Full 源域）
description: Cross frozen outer and half-primary edit direction with reciprocal total or tracked-band L2 strength. Test whether increased edit strength harms recognition even with original direction.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, source-only same physical packets and Full practical plus clean.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Same frozen 300 source V IDs, same seven native Full views and actual original W24/direct/half decisions.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen source mechanism comparison. No target input/score, clean reference, true channel, exact noise, training, or candidate selection.

sources.role: Frozen source-only 1800-update half-primary from registered parent

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original compliant frozen source models, no dynamic weights, no training or calibration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Preregistered seven-arm source diagnostic, zero checkpoint selection and no target access.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU, 3 then 7, 0, 6, at least 12 GiB free and existing process limit; 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on invalid checkpoint binding, source/physical order, archived decision mismatch, nonfinite edit diagnostics, missing views or predictions, or independent source scoring failure.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_edit_cross score-source through existing source truth-last scoring

rows.method: Direct; frozen outer and half-primary; two reciprocal total L2 crossovers; two reciprocal 1–8, 9–32, 33–64, 65–192 absolute FFT bin L2 crossovers. Preserve edge IQ and directional DC for band rows.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: Single fixed 300-packet source panel, seven views, zero updates.

notes: All edits depend on receive IQ and two previously frozen models. W24 only reads completed apertures, labels only enter through independent source scoring.
Per-band normalization uses one complex L2 per packet over eight chirps. An empty directional band stays zero. Units are absolute FFT bins.
Direction and strength comparisons are paired. Direction agreement and correct-to-wrong/wrong-to-correct counts report with same-physical-packet bootstrap.
Diagnostic only. Full user scope, no new Residual processing.
Unchanged crossover and matrix. Independent retry after initial worker exit before smoke, with updated GPU preference, startup logging, and exit code capture.
